note: Comparing two numbers by place, from the largest place down: development cases for need 35P-06, 2026-11-26, written from blueprint.json in this folder (rows C1-C6) and the standards, never from the question set. Used for design and tuning; the scoring set is separate, written later by a fresh agent from the blueprint alone, sealed. PC-01 to PC-15 are cases this need serves (8 en-US, 7 zh-CN; 7 whole numbers, 8 decimals; 2 equal pairs): expect.numbers are the two numbers as written (trailing zeros kept: 0.70), expect.relation is >, < or = read first-to-second, expect.deciding_place is the first place from the left whose digits differ (null when every place matches). PC-16 to PC-21 are near misses that belong to other needs (expect.need names it): this need's component must not be used (forbid names the tentative recipe). Chinese cases use 比大小, 从最高位比起 as Chinese learners say them.
